# SIA

> Performance appraisal platform for structured organizations — goal-setting, 360° reviews, and performance analytics for government, aviation, healthcare, and education.

SIA helps HR teams in structured, multi-tier organizations run appraisal cycles: cascade goals down the org chart, collect 360° feedback from managers and peers, and surface performance trends across units.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, target industries, and key capabilities.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create an organization workspace.
- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to an existing workspace.
